record.bible_text: Now these <FI>are<Fi> the generations<WH08435> of Esau<WH06215>, who <FI>is<Fi> Edom<WH0123>.

Esau<WH06215> took<WH03947><WTH8804> his wives<WH0802> of the daughters<WH01323> of Canaan<WH03667>; Adah<WH05711> the daughter<WH01323> of Elon<WH0356> the Hittite<WH02850>, and Aholibamah<WH0173> the daughter<WH01323> of Anah<WH06034> the daughter<WH01323> of Zibeon<WH06649> the Hivite<WH02340>;
And Bashemath<WH01315> Ishmael's<WH03458> daughter<WH01323>, sister<WH0269> of Nebajoth<WH05032>. <RF>Bashemath: or, Mahalath<Rf>
And Adah<WH05711> bare<WH03205><WTH8799> to Esau<WH06215> Eliphaz<WH0464>; and Bashemath<WH01315> bare<WH03205><WTH8804> Reuel<WH07467>;

And Aholibamah<WH0173> bare<WH03205><WTH8804> Jeush<WH03274>, and Jaalam<WH03281>, and Korah<WH07141>: these <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Esau<WH06215>, which were born<WH03205><WTH8795> unto him in the land<WH0776> of Canaan<WH03667>.

And Esau<WH06215> took<WH03947><WTH8799> his wives<WH0802>, and his sons<WH01121>, and his daughters<WH01323>, and all the persons<WH05315> of his house<WH01004>, and his cattle<WH04735>, and all his beasts<WH0929>, and all his substance<WH07075>, which he had got<WH07408><WTH8804> in the land<WH0776> of Canaan<WH03667>; and went<WH03212><WTH8799> into the country<WH0776> from the face<WH06440> of his brother<WH0251> Jacob<WH03290>. <RF>persons: Heb. souls<Rf>

For their riches<WH07399> were more<WH07227> than that they might dwell<WH03427><WTH8800> together<WH03162>; and the land<WH0776> wherein they were strangers<WH04033> could<WH03201><WTH8804> not bear<WH05375><WTH8800> them because<WH06440> of their cattle<WH04735>.
Thus dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> Esau<WH06215> in mount<WH02022> Seir<WH08165>: Esau<WH06215> <FI>is<Fi> Edom<WH0123>.<CM>
And these <FI>are<Fi> the generations<WH08435> of Esau<WH06215> the father<WH01> of the Edomites<WH0123> in mount<WH02022> Seir<WH08165>: <RF>the Edomites: Heb. Edom<Rf>

These <FI>are<Fi> the names<WH08034> of Esau's<WH06215> sons<WH01121>; Eliphaz<WH0464> the son<WH01121> of Adah<WH05711> the wife<WH0802> of Esau<WH06215>, Reuel<WH07467> the son<WH01121> of Bashemath<WH01315> the wife<WH0802> of Esau<WH06215>.
And the sons<WH01121> of Eliphaz<WH0464> were Teman<WH08487>, Omar<WH0201>, Zepho<WH06825>, and Gatam<WH01609>, and Kenaz<WH07073>. <RF>Zepho: or, Zephi<Rf>

And Timna<WH08555> was concubine<WH06370> to Eliphaz<WH0464> Esau's<WH06215> son<WH01121>; and she bare<WH03205><WTH8799> to Eliphaz<WH0464> Amalek<WH06002>: these <FI>were<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Adah<WH05711> Esau's<WH06215> wife<WH0802>.

And these <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Reuel<WH07467>; Nahath<WH05184>, and Zerah<WH02226>, Shammah<WH08048>, and Mizzah<WH04199>: these were the sons<WH01121> of Bashemath<WH01315> Esau's<WH06215> wife<WH0802>.

And these were the sons<WH01121> of Aholibamah<WH0173>, the daughter<WH01323> of Anah<WH06034> the daughter<WH01323> of Zibeon<WH06649>, Esau's<WH06215> wife<WH0802>: and she bare<WH03205><WTH8799> to Esau<WH06215> Jeush<WH03274>, and Jaalam<WH03281>, and Korah<WH07141>.

These <FI>were<Fi> dukes<WH0441> of the sons<WH01121> of Esau<WH06215>: the sons<WH01121> of Eliphaz<WH0464> the firstborn<WH01060> <FI>son<Fi> of Esau<WH06215>; duke<WH0441> Teman<WH08487>, duke<WH0441> Omar<WH0201>, duke<WH0441> Zepho<WH06825>, duke<WH0441> Kenaz<WH07073>,

Duke<WH0441> Korah<WH07141>, duke<WH0441> Gatam<WH01609>, <FI>and<Fi> duke<WH0441> Amalek<WH06002>: these <FI>are<Fi> the dukes<WH0441> <FI>that came<Fi> of Eliphaz<WH0464> in the land<WH0776> of Edom<WH0123>; these <FI>were<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Adah<WH05711>.

And these <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Reuel<WH07467> Esau's<WH06215> son<WH01121>; duke<WH0441> Nahath<WH05184>, duke<WH0441> Zerah<WH02226>, duke<WH0441> Shammah<WH08048>, duke<WH0441> Mizzah<WH04199>: these <FI>are<Fi> the dukes<WH0441> <FI> that came<Fi> of Reuel<WH07467> in the land<WH0776> of Edom<WH0123>; these <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Bashemath<WH01315> Esau's<WH06215> wife<WH0802>.

And these <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Aholibamah<WH0173> Esau's<WH06215> wife<WH0802>; duke<WH0441> Jeush<WH03266>, duke<WH0441> Jaalam<WH03281>, duke<WH0441> Korah<WH07141>: these <FI>were<Fi> the dukes<WH0441> <FI>that came<Fi> of Aholibamah<WH0173> the daughter<WH01323> of Anah<WH06034>, Esau's<WH06215> wife<WH0802>.
These <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Esau<WH06215>, who <FI>is<Fi> Edom<WH0123>, and these <FI>are<Fi> their dukes<WH0441>.<CM>

These <FI>are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of Seir<WH08165> the Horite<WH02752>, who inhabited<WH03427><WTH8802> the land<WH0776>; Lotan<WH03877>, and Shobal<WH07732>, and Zibeon<WH06649>, and Anah<WH06034>,
And Dishon<WH01787>, and Ezer<WH0687>, and Dishan<WH01789>: these <FI>are<Fi> the dukes<WH0441> of the Horites<WH02752>, the children<WH01121> of Seir<WH08165> in the land<WH0776> of Edom<WH0123>.
And the children<WH01121> of Lotan<WH03877> were Hori<WH02753> and Hemam<WH01967>; and Lotan's<WH03877> sister<WH0269> <FI>was<Fi> Timna<WH08555>. <RF>Hemam: or, Homam<Rf>

And the children<WH01121> of Shobal<WH07732> <FI>were<Fi> these; Alvan<WH05935>, and Manahath<WH04506>, and Ebal<WH05858>, Shepho<WH08195>, and Onam<WH0208>. <RF>Alvan: or, Alian<Rf> <RF>Shepho: or, Shephi<Rf>

And these <FI>are<Fi> the children<WH01121> of Zibeon<WH06649>; both Ajah<WH0345>, and Anah<WH06034>: this <FI>was that<Fi> Anah<WH06034> that found<WH04672><WTH8804> the mules<WH03222> in the wilderness<WH04057>, as he fed<WH07462><WTH8800> the asses<WH02543> of Zibeon<WH06649> his father<WH01>.
And the children<WH01121> of Anah<WH06034> <FI>were<Fi> these; Dishon<WH01787>, and Aholibamah<WH0173> the daughter<WH01323> of Anah<WH06034>.
And these <FI>are<Fi> the children<WH01121> of Dishon<WH01787>; Hemdan<WH02533>, and Eshban<WH0790>, and Ithran<WH03506>, and Cheran<WH03763>. <RF>Hemdan: or, Amram<Rf>
The children<WH01121> of Ezer<WH0687> <FI>are<Fi> these; Bilhan<WH01092>, and Zaavan<WH02190>, and Akan<WH06130>. <RF>Akan: or, Jakan<Rf>
The children<WH01121> of Dishan<WH01789> <FI>are<Fi> these; Uz<WH05780>, and Aran<WH0765>.
These <FI>are<Fi> the dukes<WH0441> <FI>that came<Fi> of the Horites<WH02752>; duke<WH0441> Lotan<WH03877>, duke<WH0441> Shobal<WH07732>, duke<WH0441> Zibeon<WH06649>, duke<WH0441> Anah<WH06034>,

Duke<WH0441> Dishon<WH01787>, duke<WH0441> Ezer<WH0687>, duke<WH0441> Dishan<WH01789>: these <FI>are<Fi> the dukes<WH0441> <FI>that came<Fi> of Hori<WH02753>, among their dukes<WH0441> in the land<WH0776> of Seir<WH08165>.<CM>

And these <FI>are<Fi> the kings<WH04428> that reigned<WH04427><WTH8804> in the land<WH0776> of Edom<WH0123>, before<WH06440> there reigned<WH04427><WTH8800> any king<WH04428> over the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>.
And Bela<WH01106> the son<WH01121> of Beor<WH01160> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in Edom<WH0123>: and the name<WH08034> of his city<WH05892> <FI>was<Fi> Dinhabah<WH01838>.
And Bela<WH01106> died<WH04191><WTH8799>, and Jobab<WH03103> the son<WH01121> of Zerah<WH02226> of Bozrah<WH01224> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.
And Jobab<WH03103> died<WH04191><WTH8799>, and Husham<WH02367> of the land<WH0776> of Temani<WH08489> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.

And Husham<WH02367> died<WH04191><WTH8799>, and Hadad<WH01908> the son<WH01121> of Bedad<WH0911>, who smote<WH05221><WTH8688> Midian<WH04080> in the field<WH07704> of Moab<WH04124>, reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead: and the name<WH08034> of his city<WH05892> <FI>was<Fi> Avith<WH05762>.
And Hadad<WH01908> died<WH04191><WTH8799>, and Samlah<WH08072> of Masrekah<WH04957> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.
And Samlah<WH08072> died<WH04191><WTH8799>, and Saul<WH07586> of Rehoboth<WH07344> <FI>by<Fi> the river<WH05104> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.
And Saul<WH07586> died<WH04191><WTH8799>, and Baalhanan<WH01177> the son<WH01121> of Achbor<WH05907> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead.

And Baalhanan<WH01177> the son<WH01121> of Achbor<WH05907> died<WH04191><WTH8799>, and Hadar<WH01924> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> in his stead: and the name<WH08034> of his city<WH05892> <FI>was<Fi> Pau<WH06464>; and his wife's<WH0802> name<WH08034> <FI>was<Fi> Mehetabel<WH04105>, the daughter<WH01323> of Matred<WH04308>, the daughter<WH01323> of Mezahab<WH04314>. <RF>Hadar, Pau: or, Hadad, Pai: after his death was an Aristocracy<Rf>

And these <FI>are<Fi> the names<WH08034> of the dukes<WH0441> <FI>that came<Fi> of Esau<WH06215>, according to their families<WH04940>, after their places<WH04725>, by their names<WH08034>; duke<WH0441> Timnah<WH08555>, duke<WH0441> Alvah<WH05933>, duke<WH0441> Jetheth<WH03509>, <RF>Alvah: or, Aliah<Rf>
Duke<WH0441> Aholibamah<WH0173>, duke<WH0441> Elah<WH0425>, duke<WH0441> Pinon<WH06373>,
Duke<WH0441> Kenaz<WH07073>, duke<WH0441> Teman<WH08487>, duke<WH0441> Mibzar<WH04014>,
